summary: Enable shadow traffic feature flags for internal dogfood tenant (Shadow Experiments + quality scoring)
description:
Request
- Please enable Shadow Traffic (shadow experiments) feature flags for the internal dogfood tenant so Console & Rollouts can run end-to-end testing before Dedicated beta.

Tenant
- Tenant name: redwood-internal
- Tenant ID: tnt_internal_01HMWK2J7D7VQ8A9B2K4 (per Console)
- Org/Project: Internal / DevRel + Platform (shared)

Requested flags (control plane + console)
1) shadow_traffic_policies_enabled = true
2) shadow_experiments_console_enabled = true
3) shadow_scoring_pipeline_enabled = true
4) shadow_streaming_mirroring_enabled = false (keep off for initial dogfood)

Scope / guardrails
- Sampling: max 1% on selected routes only (per runbook); no global defaults.
- Fail-open required: any shadow routing/scoring failure must not affect primary response.
- Retention: default 24h for prompts/responses; metrics aggregates retained per standard.
- RBAC: limit experiment create/edit permissions to Console & Tooling eng + PMs listed below.

Approvals requested
- Product: Marissa Cole
- Eng: Dylan Brooks (Console), Ethan Park (Control plane)
- SRE: Sean Gallagher (oncall readiness)
- Security: Marcus Lin (retention/redaction default acknowledgement)

Why now
- Needed for Phase 1 dogfood milestone to validate routing mirroring + telemetry + scoring + Console deltas on real-ish traffic without customer exposure.

Rollback / kill switch
- If any degradation observed (metrics cardinality, ingestion lag, increased p99 on user path), disable shadow_scoring_pipeline_enabled first, then shadow_traffic_policies_enabled.
- Refer to Shadow Traffic rollout/rollback runbook for exact steps.

Acceptance criteria
- Flags enabled for tnt_internal_01HMWK2J7D7VQ8A9B2K4 in prod (us-east) only.
- Confirmed by Console: “Shadow Experiments” nav appears and API returns 200 for list/create.
- Audit log entry recorded for flag changes and attached to this ticket.
